title: Geologic map of the New Ellenton SE quadrangle, Aiken and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 1997, Geologic map of the New Ellenton SE quadrangle, Aiken and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-105, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet with a long OCR'd explanation printed in several columns, so OCR lines interleave columns; quotes are single-line excerpts. Symbols me, Qal 2, Qcb and Tp read from legend boxes on page images; OCR 'Tab' read as Tdb. The text gives two different logs under drill hole 2-493 (a 12-ft Qal 1 flood-plain section with peat dated 11,110 +50 B.P., and a 23-ft Qal 2 terrace section with three dated organic beds); both recorded as printed. Radiocarbon dates kept in interval descriptions. OCR '1 1feet' read as 11 feet (inferred). Many map-face drill-hole labels and the long reference list were not all recorded (thirteen SC-relevant references kept). SUBSURFACE: about 4 ft of incision between 37,950 and 11,110 B.P. (terrace base 197 ft vs flood-plain base 193 ft); radiocarbon ages of the organic beds.
